ov: زاثيورا: مغامرة الفضاء (الإنجليزية: Zathura: A Space Adventure) هو فيلم خيالي أمريكي من مخرج جون فافرو، الذي صدر في عام 2005، ومقتبسة من كتاب زاثيورا من قبل كريس فان السبرغ نشرت في عام 2002.
plotEn:
Walter and his brother Danny live in a suburban house, alongside their father, and teenage sister Lisa. One day, while their father is away at work, Danny discovers an old science fiction-themed board game called Zathura in the basement. Out of boredom and a desire to bond with his brother, Danny starts playing, and the game produces a card that warns of him of an impending meteor shower.
A meteor shower strikes the house. Walter and Danny realize the game has affected their reality after noticing the house has been ripped from its foundation, and transported deep into outer space. Lisa wakes up from her nap and prepares to leave for a date, only to be put in cryonic sleep. The brothers learn that they must finish playing the game to return to Earth and restore normalcy.
Walter and Danny confront the dangers presented by the game, including a faulty robot, passing too close to a star, and an attack by a race of reptilian aliens known as Zorgons. In one of Danny's turns, an astronaut appears and instructs them to eliminate the house's heat sources, since the Zorgons are attracted to heat. The astronaut distracts the Zorgons' ship by setting the couch on fire and ejecting it from the house.
